summary: Trusted verification passed (exit 0): typecheck + 432 tests, privacy:check (71), cost:check (21, 10 gates), expo export android+ios, prebuild and assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Candidate delta is a single +24-line regression guard in __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts asserting the finalizer workflow emulator step uses the single-line 'script: bash scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh' form; the test passes and the workflow YAML is valid. However, the candidate MISDIAGNOSES the failure it was asked to repair: GitHub API shows run 35413347057 ran with head_sha 0f36b1f ('Fix V3 finalizer emulator shell'), i.e. the workflow ALREADY contained the single-line form when the run executed. The run failed at step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' with exit code 1 (annotation: 'The process /usr/bin/sh failed with exit code 1') after ~10 minutes (01:56:21Z -> 02:06:21Z). The multi-line script: | form was NOT the cause of this failure, and the candidate changes nothing that affects the emulator step, scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh, scripts/e2e-android.js or the app, so the concrete blocker remains unfixed and the trusted finalizer cannot pass. Historical evidence: all 5 actual finalizer runs (11, 12, 14, 16, 22) failed at the same emulator step; runs 11/12/14/16 used the multi-line form (reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2 parseScript line-splits and executes each line via sh -c, where dash rejects 'set -euo pipefail' with exit 2 — verified from the action source), while run 22 used the single-line form and failed with exit 1, a different root cause. The 'successful' schedule runs (9, 10, 13, 15, 17-21) never executed the release job (skipped, pendingArtifact not set). No regressions: the only difference vs pristine is the test file; all V3-01..V3-07 suites remain green. Decision: repair — the mustFix (trusted finalizer failure) remains open; the regression guard is coherent and preserved as WIP baseline, but the next cycle must obtain the actual step-7 logs of run 35413347057 and fix the concrete emulator/APK-install/E2E blocker.

The candidate changes nothing that affects the emulator step, scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh, scripts/e2e-android.js or the app, so the concrete blocker is unfixed and the trusted finalizer cannot pass. The test comment's root-cause claim ('the multi-line script: | form ... exits 2 before the APK install and golden path ever run' for run 35413347057) is factually incorrect.
